blocks.text: Network security computer networks ki hifazat ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh data ko be-ijazat (unauthorized) rasai se mehfooz rakhti hai. Security data ke zaya hone aur nuqsan se bachati hai. Rozana bohat se log networks se jurte hain. Security ke baghair networks ghair-mehfooz ho jate hain. Network security mukhtalif tools aur qawaid istemal karti hai. Yeh gharon aur idaron dono ke liye zaroori hai. Network security zaati aur ahem maloomat ki hifazat karti hai. Yeh hackers ko network mein ghusne se rokti hai. Security data ko raaz mein aur mehfooz rakhti hai. Yeh devices ko malware (nuqsan deh software) se bhi bachati hai. Mehfooz networks be-rukawat aur hamwaar chalte hain. Har network ko bunyadi security iqdamat (measures) chahiye.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Baat karein ke security hassas (sensitive) data, jaise hospital mein mareezon ke CT scans, ki hifazat kaise karti hai.

Firewall ek security device ya software hai. Yeh network mein aane aur jane wale traffic ko control karta hai. Firewalls nuqsan deh ya na-pasandeeda data ko rok dete hain (jaise Figure 1.17 mein). Yeh mehfooz aur ghair-mehfooz networks ke darmiyan deewar (barrier) ka kaam karte hain. Firewalls computers ko hamlon (attacks) se bachate hain. Yeh gharon aur daftaron mein istemal hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen taraf aag se laal teer aate hain jo eenton ki deewar par ruk jate hain, jis par sabz tick wali neeli dhaal (shield) hai; deewar se sabz teer daayen taraf computer tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.17: Firewall ki hifazat (kitab ki Figure 1.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Encryption data ko khufia (secret) shakal mein badal deti hai. Sirf ijazat wale (authorized) users hi encrypted data parh sakte hain. Yeh muntaqili ke dauran data ki hifazat karti hai. Encryption emails aur online banking mein istemal hoti hai. Mazboot encryption data ki security behtar karti hai. Yeh data ki chori rokti hai.

Access control tay karta hai ke network kaun istemal kar sakta hai. Yeh sirf ijazat wale users ko andar aane deta hai. Usernames aur passwords aam access controls hain. Permissions (ijazatein) had muqarrar karti hain ke users kya kar sakte hain. Access control ahem resources ki hifazat karta hai. Yeh network ka istemal sambhalne mein madad deta hai.

Network security ko bohat se khatre hain. Viruses aur malware systems ko nuqsan pohanchate hain. Hackers data churane ki koshish karte hain. Phishing users ko dhoka de kar maloomat nikalwati hai. Denial of Service (DoS) hamle network ki services rok dete hain. Security tools in khatron ko kam karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Har tool ko us ke kaam se milayein: firewall, encryption, access control.
blocks.explanation: Firewall: networks ke darmiyan traffic chhanta hai. Encryption: data ko key ke baghair na-qabil-e-parhai banati hai. Access control: tay karta hai ke network kaun use kare aur kya kare.

items: Network security data aur devices ko be-ijazat rasai, hackers aur malware se bachati hai.
Tools: firewall (traffic rokta/chhanta), encryption (khufia shakal), access control (kaun aaye, kya kare).
Khatre: viruses aur malware, hackers, phishing, denial of service.
